The Storm Explorer is loaded with features to allow you to explore the paths of storms in the North Atlantic. In this tab, you will find some basic instructions on how to run the model and share the model with others.

Storm Explorer Instructions

To create one storm track:

1) Click on the “Storm Setup” button in the bottom control bar.

2) Use the Storm Setup panel to set the storm location, storm category, season, the sea surface temperature anomalies, and pressure systems for the simulation.

3) When you are happy with the initial conditions, close the Storm Setup panel.

4) Click “Start” to run the storm.

To create multiple storm tracks (TBD):

1) Click on the “Multiple Tracks” button in the bottom control bar.

2) Click on the “Storm Setup” button in the bottom control bar.

3) Use the Storm Setup panel to set the initial conditions of the storm.

4) When you are happy with the initial conditions, close the Storm Setup panel.

5) Click “Start” to run the storm.

6) If you like this track, click the “Save” button in the Setup panel.

7) Repeat several times.

CLUE Instructions

When you are ready, share this document (including the Storm Explorer) with others by:

1) Clicking the “Share” toggle in the upper right (It will change from gray to blue)

2) Go to the pink “Model Gallery” tab on the left side of the screen.

3) You should be able to see your document in this tab.

To comment on others’ documents:

1) The left side of your window is called the Models and Forecasts side. The right side is the workspace.

2) Go to the “Model Gallery” tab on the left side of the screen

3) Click on someone else' s document.

4) Click on the “Comment” icon in the upper right corner of the Models dna Forecast side.

5) When the comment panel is open, click on the Storm Explorer on the dashboard side.

6) Write your comment and click on the “Post” button.
